Again, I am hoping you meant all "serious" candidates, as to have a debate between literally "all the candidates" is simply unfeasible.

I like what I think you meant, however, which is to have more debates among the candidates behind whom there is significant public interest, and to have the format of the debates allow for all candidates on the stage to have a crack at a given issue, rather than moderators' questions targeting a candidate on one of their strengths or weaknesses.
